description: A shell script to install a CA certificate into the Java trust store, including functions for downloading, deleting, and managing certificates, with environment setup instructions.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a command, printing it with formatting before evaluation.

methods.name: determineTrustStoreOrKeyStoreLocation
methods.description: Determines the location of the Java trust store or keystore based on JAVA_HOME.

methods.name: downloadCertificate
methods.description: Downloads the CA certificate from a specified URL.

methods.name: deleteDownloadedCertificate
methods.description: Deletes the downloaded CA certificate file.

methods.name: removeIfAlreadyInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is already installed and removes it if so.

methods.name: installCertificate
methods.description: Main function to install the CA certificate into the Java trust store.
